name: io.github.bhargava-gumpula/switchboard
title: Switchboard
description: Coordinates AI coding agents through a shared FalkorDB import graph: claims, conflicts, memory.

environmentVariables.name: SB_GRAPH
environmentVariables.description: Graph name. Default: sb_<repo name>, shared by every worktree of the repo

environmentVariables.description: Editor part of the agent id <editor>@<branch>, e.g. cursor or claude-code
